messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — launching a small pilot called 'Flex Pause' starting May 1. Each person gets 2 Flex Pause days to use for short interruptions (doctor, family pickup, mental reset). Up to 4 hours per instance is auto-approved; anything longer still needs manager approval. Full details: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/flex-pause :sparkles:

Devon (Eng): Clarify — auto-approval applies only to partial days (<=4h) or can someone take a full day and tag it as Flex Pause?

Maya (People Ops): Only partial days are auto-approved. Full-day PTO still goes through the normal approval flow. We added a checkbox in the time-off form: `Use Flex Pause (auto-approve if <=4h)`.

Samir (Platform): For teams with oncall — any guidance for handoffs when people take a Flex Pause?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — we added delegation templates and a short oncall handoff checklist in the doc. Example snippet you can copy:```OOO 11:30-15:30 — delegating alerts to @devon. Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood.com/playbooks/oncall```

Leah (People Ops): Also rolling out a manager digest that shows Flex Pause usage per direct report (weekly email). Managers can request exception reviews if they see repeated patterns.

Ben (Recruiting): Does this change interview scheduling constraints or candidate availability rules? Trying to coordinate calendar slots across EMEA/APAC.

Maya (People Ops): No change to interview rules. Recruiters should assume standard availability; if a Flex Pause blocks a scheduled interview, please nudge the interviewer to swap. We'll add a short note to the interviewing handbook.

Devon (Eng): Thanks. Small ask — can the calendar entry auto-tag as `Flex Pause` so people know it's not PTO?

Maya (People Ops): Yup, the time-off flow creates a `Flex Pause` calendar event (team-visible) by default. If you prefer private, toggle the visibility in the form.

HR-bot: Policy doc updated by Maya. https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/flex-pause — reactions welcomed :doc:

Samir (Platform): Appreciate the templates. Will paste the oncall handoff into our team handbook now.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone — we'll run the pilot for 6 months, collect manager feedback, and revisit. Ping me or Leah for exceptions or questions.
